title: Twin Spiral Eyes
description: Two large overlapping circular forms with black spiral patterns and stylized eyes float against a vibrant cosmic background. The left orb is warm orange with multiple eye motifs, while the right is cooler purple, both crowned by larger almond-shaped eyes containing spirals.
prompt: psychedelic surreal painting featuring two large overlapping orbs with intricate black spiral patterns and multiple stylized eyes embedded within them, left orb glowing warm orange, right orb deep purple, both topped with large almond eyes containing spirals, set against a swirling cosmic background of yellow, magenta and deep blue nebulous clouds with glowing particles, mystical symbolic art
